title: A Phase 2, Randomized, Open-Label Study Of Axatilimab Versus Best Available Therapy in Pediatric Participants With Chronic Graft Versus Host Disease After at Least 2 Prior Lines of Systemic Therapy (AGAVE-256)
official: A Phase 2, Randomized, Open-Label Study Of Axatilimab Versus Best Available Therapy in Pediatric Participants With Chronic Graft Versus Host Disease After at Least 2 Prior Lines of Systemic Therapy (AGAVE-256)
summary:
Main objective: To assess the efficacy of axatilimab monotherapy
versus BAT in cGVHD.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1.	Aged 2 to < 18 years at the time of randomization.
2. 10.	Participants must accept to be treated with one of the following BAT options on C1D1: CNI (cyclosporine or tacrolimus), ECP, MMF, an mTOR inhibitor (everolimus or sirolimus), rituximab, imatinib, methotrexate, ibrutinib or pentostatin.
3. 11.	Willingness to avoid pregnancy or fathering children
4. 2.	Ability to comprehend and willingness to sign a written ICF for the study. A parent/guardian should provide consent for pediatric participants unable to provide consent themselves; in addition, where applicable, pediatric participants should sign their own assent form.
5. 3.	Active, moderate to severe cGVHD requiring systemic immune suppression.
6. 4.	History of allo-HCT from any donor HLA type (related or unrelated donor with any degree of HLA matching) using any graft source (bone marrow, peripheral blood stem cells, or cord blood).
7. 5.	Participants with refractory or recurrent active cGVHD who have received at least 2 lines of systemic therapy for cGVHD, including corticosteroids and ruxolitinib.
8. 6.	Participants may have overlap cGVHD
9. 7.	Karnofsky Performance Scale of ≥ 60 (if aged ≥ 16 years); Lansky Performance Score of ≥ 60 (if aged < 16 years).
10. 8.	Adequate hematologic function, defined as ANC ≥ 0.5 × 109/L and platelet count ≥ 20 × 109/L (with or without transfusion).
11. 9.	Concomitant use of systemic corticosteroids is allowed, but not required. Participants on systemic corticosteroids must be on a stable dose of corticosteroids for at least 2 weeks prior to C1D1. Topical and inhaled corticosteroid agents are allowed.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1.	Received more than 1 prior allo-HCT. Prior autologous HCT is allowed, including autologous CAR T-cell therapy given before the allo-SCT.
2. 10.	Systemic treatment with CNIs or mTOR inhibitors started within 2 weeks prior to C1D1.
3. 11.	Previous exposure to CSF-1R–targeted therapies.
4. 12. For approved, investigational, and/or commonly used systemic treatments for cGVHD (other than corticosteroids, CNIs, and mTOR inhibitors), a washout of 2 weeks or 5 half lives, whichever is longer, is required before C1D1.
5. 13.	Treatment with an investigational agent, procedure, or device (for non-cGVHD indication) within 30 days before C1D1, or within 5 half-lives of the investigational product, whichever is longer.
6. 14.	Active, uncontrolled infection despite appropriate therapy at the time of screening.
7. 15.	Active HBV or HCV infection that requires treatment or at risk for HBV reactivation (ie, positive HBsAg).
8. 16.	Known HIV seropositive status.
9. 17.	Suspected active or latent tuberculosis (as confirmed by a positive tuberculosis blood test).
10. 18.	Administration of live-attenuated vaccines within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study treatment or anticipated need for live-attenuated vaccines while on study treatment.
11. 19.	Female adolescent participants who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
12. 2.	Has aGVHD without manifestations of cGVHD.
13. 20.	Participants must not participate in any other interventional study.
14. 21.	Any condition that would, in the investigator's judgment, interfere with full participation in the study, including administration of study drug and attending required study visits; pose a significant risk to the participant; or interfere with interpretation of study data.
15. 22.	The following participants are excluded in France: vulnerable populations according to article L.1121-6 of the French Public Health Code and adults under legal protection, or who are unable to express their consent per article L.1121-8 of the French Public Health Code, not affiliated to a social security per article L.1121-8-1 of the French Public Health Code.
16. 3.	Documented evidence of relapse of the primary hematologic disease or receipt of treatment for relapse after allo-SCT, including DLI for treatment of any malignancy relapse, including molecular relapse.
17. 4.	Maintenance therapy for the primary hematologic disease started within 4 weeks before initiation of study treatment (Day 1) or plans to start maintenance therapy after Day 1.
18. 5.	Severe renal impairment, that is, GFR < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 as estimated using modified Schwartz formula, or end-stage renal disease on dialysis.
19. 6.	Impaired liver function, defined as total bilirubin > 1.5 × ULN or ALT > 3 × ULN or AST > 3 × ULN in participants with no evidence of liver cGVHD.
20. 7.	History of acute or chronic pancreatitis.
21. 8.	Active, symptomatic myositis.
22. 9.	Known allergies, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to any of the study medications, excipients, or similar compounds.
